harness_input_refusal_class.why: F18: the harness refuses a run unless the flow has exactly one file-input step (ABT _runtime_file_step_id); rule unreviewed (adjudication A3). One such case (mb_int09) stays as its own stratum; the rest wait for H1/A3.

review_edit_target_until_h2.why: The review-edit oracle finds its target by leaf NAMES from the case oracle (ABT _review_target_edit); a valid flow with a differently named review field stops the run as review_target_missing. Until the typed H2 check exists these cases can turn a naming difference into a delivery failure, so they are excluded (the ones already excluded above stay in their own group).
